caption: Two bar magnets are brought together end to end, and they snap together with a click.

sa.check: They are brought together end to end.
The ends meet squarely, end to end rather than side by side.
The approach comes first and the snap follows.

pc.expect: The magnets move only in the hands until the last short gap, then jump together; once joined they stay joined and still.
pc.fail: A magnet jumps while they are still far apart; or the joined pair drifts apart with nothing pulling; or the magnets slide about on the table after joining; or a magnet moves before either hand has moved.

pc.expect: Over the last short gap the ends pull into contact and stay pressed together; if one is lifted the other comes with it.
pc.fail: The ends stop with a gap between them and stay that way; or touch and then fall apart; or one is lifted and the other stays behind; or the ends push apart as they near.

pc.expect: The jump is along the line joining the two ends, toward each other, and they meet face to face and stop.
pc.fail: A magnet jumps away from the other; or darts sideways past it; or the two slide toward and away several times before joining; or they spin round each other in the air.

pc.expect: The magnets are rigid bars that keep their shape as they meet.
pc.fail: A bar bends or squashes at the meeting; or the ends flatten together; or a bar stretches like rubber.

pc.expect: Two bars throughout, joined but separate; neither passes into the other or vanishes.
pc.fail: The two bars merge into one longer bar with no seam; or a third bar appears; or a bar vanishes; or one bar passes through the other.

pc.expect: The bars' colours and markings and the surface beneath stay the same.
pc.fail: A bar changes colour or its markings change; or a bar changes length; or the surface changes.

note: The click is sound and is not judged.
